description:
Compose the preselected A241 B-query repair with A240's A-query repair.

Layer2 input geometry is identical to the A241 calibration parent. Changing
layer2 queries changes downstream text inputs, so the retained layer3 repair
has no exact joint prediction guarantee; official full scoring is required.
No new fit, scale, or residual target is introduced.

query_analysis.editable_support_policy: Only output channels already differing from HOST in more than90percent of their640 input coefficients; all remaining rows stay bit-identical to parent
query_analysis.source_validation_scope: Only128 current exact-input format windows; no historical layer2 input population is assumed to match the parent
query_analysis.target: Original HOST minus original parent normalized-query causal scores at exact parent inputs and fixed original query raw RMS
query_analysis.basis_construction: One original-response canonical input covariance and one original-response PCA output covariance per head, training only
query_analysis.metric: Exact mean-centered causal recorded-key Gram for the fixed original normalization linear correction; each rounded candidate is checked with its actual query RMS
query_analysis.selection: Each head independently selects least heldback score MSE among source-safe candidates, or keeps its original query; combined mean MSE must improve10percent
query_analysis.scope_limit: No attention probabilities, native output trajectory or final text prediction improvement is claimed; official score required

extra.scope: Layer2 query/key input algebra is shared exactly. Layer3 word inputs change; retained A240 layer3 repair and later behavior require official score.
